evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition frames self-origination and possession of capability as the appealed-to good, carrying both autonomy (your own) and self-enhancement (keeping the asset).

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Names the self-originated perspective as the retained asset, appealing to autonomy (your own perspective) and self-enhancement (the asset you keep) simultaneously.
